name: strikethroo-viewer
description: Opens the active Strikethroo plan in strikethroo serve: checks whether it already answers on 127.0.0.1, starts it with no shell when it doesn't, and shows a link. Never binds anything but loopback.

serve_command.title: Serve command
serve_command.description: The command that starts the viewer, split on spaces and run with no shell, in the project directory. --port is added. --host is refused.

port.title: Port
port.description: The loopback port the viewer listens on.
